items.reason: A once-nightly gel that suits adult skin and supports a smoother, clearer-looking complexion.
Daily mineral sunscreen is needed alongside adapalene, which makes skin more sun-sensitive.

response.routine_note: Apply a thin layer of the gel at night, starting every second or third night, and wear the SPF every morning. Because three months of shop-bought products have not changed how your skin looks, a dermatologist is the better next step than adding more products from us.
